technology_name: SMALL MOLECULES WITH AZACYCLONOL AND PIOGLITAZONE COMBINATIONS TO MIMIC THE EFFECTS OF ISCHEMIC PRECONDITIONING AGAINST CEREBRAL STROKE
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Ischemic damage from acute cerebral strokes causes rapid neuronal death, creating a bottleneck for effective preventative chemical preconditioning defenses.
description: An advanced small-molecule therapeutic composition combining azacyclonol and pioglitazone compounds, designed to induce artificial ischemic preconditioning cascades that mitigate cellular stroke injuries.
applications: Prophylactic stroke management for high-risk cohorts, post-ischemic neurological rehabilitation regimens, surgical cerebral protection protocols, and emergency stroke care medicine.
